verified_from_source.duplicate_delivery: Single durable claim per delivery ID; same payload completed retry mints a fresh receipt without another Auth/email call. Started/unknown provider or completion outcome is indeterminate and cannot automatically resend. This is bounded per-delivery protection, not exactly-once email delivery or a completed operator reconciliation feature.
